cid.note: compute = CIDv1 sha2-256 of the bytes as one block; text_default is Kubo's form, text_58btc the z form. unixfs inputs with ramp=true are byte i = i & 255.

coin.note: holdings are sparse [[tier,count],...]; split rungs are given only when the split has at most 64 coins

scenario.note: issuer keys: zxv_mldsa87_keygen_seed with seed = 32 bytes of 0x40+k; peg signatures: zxv_mldsa87_sign_deterministic, empty context. Steps run in order on one hub; accounts are numbered in order of creation.

freight.note: packets are the 168 rows of 21 bytes, in order; decode rows are row indices into them. ramp payloads are byte i = i & 255.

ops_encode.utf8: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog; the quick brown fox
the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog; the quick brown fox

web4.note: agent keys from seed = 32 bytes of `seed_byte`; bound at now_ms. ML-DSA-65 signatures here are hedged (random), so each signed encoding is given as its length and the bytes before its trailing 3309-byte signature.

consent.check_note: checks run in order on one log of capacity 16; the last check uses a second token with nonce[0] ^= 0xff, revoked before it is checked

paradox.note: tags are zxv_hex tags (base<<4|polarity<<2|phase; base false 0, neither 1, both 2, true 3; polarity entropic 0, neutral 1, forbidden 2, negentropic 3). Every step below runs in order on ONE book created with log capacity 64 and registry capacity 16; -1 in a table marks ZXV_E_ARG.

constructive.note: policy 'plain' has flags 0, 'money' flags MONEY; both start at initial
